children: Sri Lankan shares closed lower on Friday, extending losses for a fifth straight session, dragged down by utility stocks.
* The index dropped 2.52% over the week, its fourth straight weekly fall

* Trading volume on the index fell to 31.5 million shares from 64.3 million shares in the previous session
* The equity market's turnover dipped to 825.1 million Sri Lankan rupees ($2.48 million) from 1.10 billion rupees in the previous session, according to exchange data
* Foreign investors were net buyers, purchasing stocks worth 55.1 million rupees, while domestic investors were net sellers, offloading shares worth 807.6 million rupees, the data showed
